verdict: Paid channels are fully dark; organic presence alone is holding the line.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, zero dollars were spent on paid advertising — no Meta, no Google Ads — meaning every engagement came entirely from your Google Business Profiles. Combined, those profiles generated 395 actions (23 calls, 254 directions, 118 web clicks) over the last 28 days, which shows real local demand. However, organic momentum is softening: Advance Grinding's profile engagement fell 55% week-over-week and O'Hare Precision's dropped 21%, with Forte Metals showing early signs of a similar cool-down after its earlier spike. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to convert that organic interest into trackable leads before the softening deepens.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and site visits
dollars spent on paid advertising this period across Meta and Google Ads combined
week-over-week drop in profile engagement at Advance Grinding, the sharpest single-location decline this period

watch_item.issue: Organic engagement is declining across locations at the same time paid channels remain inactive, leaving lead generation with no backup source.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is being prioritized now to run alongside the organic profiles and capture demand that currently has nowhere to convert.
